meta.title: Your AI Real Estate Team — RealtyBoss
meta.description: RealtyBoss is an AI team for real estate agents — an AI receptionist that answers every call, a sales assistant that follows up, plus marketing, transaction, and accounting assistants. Never miss a call or a lead again.
meta.og_title: Your AI Real Estate Team — RealtyBoss
meta.og_description: An AI team that answers the phone, follows up, markets your listings, coordinates the deal, and keeps the books.
meta.twitter_title: Your AI Real Estate Team — RealtyBoss
meta.twitter_description: An AI team that answers the phone, follows up, and closes.

receptionist.name: AI Receptionist
receptionist.body: Picks up live calls, qualifies the caller, books showings and appointments, and texts back instantly when you can't answer. Your phone is never unattended again.

boss.name: Boss Assistant
boss.body: You're the boss — just say what you want done. Your Boss Assistant figures out who should handle it, delegates to the right teammate, and reports back. One command in; the whole team to work.

sales.name: Sales Assistant
sales.body: Cold-calls and qualifies new leads (budget, timeline, motivation — buyer or seller), follows up with a real voice call — not just an SMS — plus text and email, runs CMAs and listing presentations, and never lets a sphere touch slip.

marketing.name: Marketing Assistant
marketing.body: Generates leads, nurtures your sphere, and keeps you visible — campaigns, content, and outreach that bring new business while you work the ones you have.

transaction.name: Transaction Assistant
transaction.body: Drives every deal from accepted offer to keys — coordinator board, offers, and a per-deal coach for pricing, risk, and negotiation.

accountant.name: Accountant
accountant.body: Invoices, expenses, and commission tracking — so you always know what's earned, what's owed, and what closed.

hero.subtitle: You're the boss — give one command to your Boss Assistant and it arranges the work: the receptionist answers, sales follows up, marketing fills the pipeline, and transactions and accounting handle the rest. You finally own a real team.

voice.body_lead: Every other CRM stops at SMS and email drips. RealtyBoss picks up the phone — answering inbound calls 24/7
voice.body_bold: and placing real outbound voice calls
voice.body_tail: to follow up with your sphere and leads. That conversation is what wins the listing.

sphere_followup.title: Calls your sphere to follow up
sphere_followup.body: This is the part no other CRM does: your AI places real voice calls to past clients and leads — check-ins, nurture, market updates — by phone, not just another text.

cold_call.title: Cold-calls & qualifies new leads
cold_call.body: Hand it a lead list and it dials, qualifies on budget, timeline, and motivation — buyer or seller — and scores who's ready, so you spend time only on hot prospects.

answers_live.title: Answers live, in your voice
answers_live.body: A natural AI voice picks up inbound calls, answers questions about a listing, and qualifies the caller — day or night.

language.title: Talks in your client's language — automatically
language.body: Every assistant detects the language a client speaks and replies in it — English, 中文, and more — on calls and in texts, with no setup or toggle. Serve your whole market without hiring bilingual staff.

text_back.title: Missed-call text-back
text_back.body: Can't pick up? The moment a call ends unanswered, the caller gets a friendly text in seconds — before they call the next agent.

books.title: Books showings & appointments
books.body: Captures intent and puts the appointment on your calendar, then hands a qualified lead to the Sales Assistant.

every_call.title: Every call becomes a lead
every_call.body: Inbound and outbound calls are logged, transcribed, and added to your pipeline automatically — no sticky notes, no lost numbers.

meet.subtitle: Tell the Boss Assistant what you want done — it arranges the work and puts the right teammate on it, around the clock. You finally own a real team, without the payroll, so you can do the part only you can: build relationships and close.

training.h2: Trained on how top agents actually sell
training.subtitle: Your team isn't a chatbot with a real-estate coat of paint. Every script, follow-up, and call is modeled on the playbooks of top-producing agents — how they qualify, handle objections, price, and negotiate.

scripts.title: Proven scripts & talk tracks
scripts.body: Calls and messages use the language top producers use to build rapport and move a conversation forward — not generic chatbot filler.

objections.title: Objection handling that converts
objections.body: Knows the real answers to "we're just looking," "your commission is too high," and "we'll wait for the market" — and keeps the lead engaged.

cadence.title: Follow-up cadence that wins
cadence.body: Times outreach the way the best agents do — fast first touch, then a persistent, polite rhythm that earns the appointment.

pricing.title: Pricing & negotiation instincts
pricing.body: Frames value, anchors price, and qualifies motivation with the judgment of an experienced listing and buyer's agent.

economics.subtitle: A receptionist, an ISA, a transaction coordinator, a marketing assistant, and a bookkeeper would cost you tens of thousands a year — each — and you'd still have to hire, train, and manage them. RealtyBoss gives you all of them, trained to sell like top producers, for the price of a tool.

chips.never_quits: Never quits, never calls in sick
chips.trained: Trained to sell like top agents

command_chain.h2: You give one order. The team does the rest.
command_chain.subtitle: Pick a command and watch it cascade — the Boss Assistant plans it and assigns the right teammates, who do the research and every step for you.

final_cta.h2: Never miss a call — or a lead — again
final_cta.subtitle: Put an AI team to work today. They answer, follow up, and coordinate. You close.
